svg.title: Umbra Unit Frames — the onboarding
svg.text: The first login asks what /uuf sets, one question to a page, each with a drawing of what the answer does.
Every answer takes effect the moment it is clicked; Skip keeps the defaults, and /uuf setup brings the

g.text: Each layout remembers where you've moved your
frames, so feel free to try both.
Neutral keeps class color on the edge and the name.
Class color paints the bar as well.

svg.text: Class color picked: the bar takes the unit's color

g.text: On the portrait, before the name, or not at all. On
a target, the color shows how tough it is.

svg.text: In front of the name: the plate on the portrait

g.text: Umbra already shows your buffs and party. Keep the
group manager if you use its raid markers.

svg.text: Buffs put away, drawn dashed; the group manager

g.text: That's it! Unlock the frames below to move them, or
puts the frames back in place

svg.text: No minimap switch: the client has its addon
